name: Lucky Snow Delight
desc: A Liyue confection made from rice. The grains are ground into flour and then mixed with sugar and water before being pressed into molds and steamed to become a snow-white cake that evokes the promise of a rich and plentiful harvest.

value.text: Restores 32% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 730 HP every 5s for 30s.
